## Report: Remaining Page/Component Audit

**Portal pages** (all `usePortalStore`, wizard-with-`StickyFooter` pattern, className-based utility classes, minimal inline styles):

| File | Style/type | Styling approach | Notable for redesign |
|---|---|---|---|
| `portal/dashboard/page.tsx` | 3-step wizard (Entity→Status→Actions) posing as a "dashboard" | Utility classes (`card`, `flex`, `text-*`) + `ProgressSteps`/`StatusCard`/`ListItem` design-system components; near-zero inline styles | Real dashboard content (stats, pipeline) crammed into a mobile step-wizard; on desktop this should be a real multi-panel dashboard, not sequential steps |
| `portal/vault/page.tsx` | 3-step wizard (Entity→Documents→Upload/KYC), doc grid | Same utility-class pattern; `Modal` for share link | Document grid (`sm:grid-cols-2`) is the only page with any responsive breakpoint; everything else is wizard-locked |
| `portal/renewals/page.tsx` | 2-step wizard (Overview→Payment), invoice/cost breakdown list | Utility classes | Straightforward; horizontal-scroll entity picker (`overflow-x-auto`) won't scale to desktop |
| `portal/settings/page.tsx` | 3-step wizard (Profile→Entities→Notifications) | Utility classes | Small `Link` with raw `style={{textDecoration:'none'}}` — one of the few inline styles here |
| `portal/banking/page.tsx` | 3-step wizard (Select Bank→Pre-Flight→Status), card-list selector | Utility classes | Repeats bank-summary card markup twice (step 0 selector + step 2 status) almost verbatim — duplicated pattern |
| `portal/tax-compliance/page.tsx` | 3-step wizard + tabbed sub-view (Returns/Expenses) + Modal form | Utility classes | Tab-in-wizard nesting is convoluted; good candidate to flatten into a real dashboard/table on desktop |

**Other consumer pages:**

| File | Style/type | Styling approach | Notable |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tools/page.tsx` | Tool gallery/dashboard (category filters + 2-col card grid + active calculator workspace) | **Heavy raw inline `style={{}}`** throughout (~30+ objects), mixed with utility classes | Every icon-tile (`width:36,height:36,borderRadius:10...`) hand-duplicated inline; 2-column grid hardcoded (`gridTemplateColumns:'1fr 1fr'`), no desktop breakpoint |
| `checkout/page.tsx` | Thin wrapper, just a Suspense boundary | Inline `<style>` string block for spinner keyframes | Trivial; real logic lives in `CheckoutForm` |
| `setup/page.tsx` | Thin wrapper for `OnboardingWizard` | Inline style for loading state only | Trivial |
| `components/onboarding/OnboardingWizard.tsx` (lines 120-434) | 5-step formation wizard (Activity→Jurisdiction→Tier→Add-ons→Summary) | **Near-100% raw inline styles** — dozens of hand-built `style={{...}}` objects for cards, grids, badges, spacing | 434 lines total, large; icon-tile pattern (`width:36,height:36,borderRadius:10,background:...`) duplicated 3+ times; 2-col grids hardcoded, no desktop layout |
| `components/checkout/CheckoutForm.tsx` | Payment form (founder info, split-payment picker, card/wire tabs) + success state | **Near-100% raw inline styles**, same as above | 322 lines; fake/demo payment data prefilled (`cardNumber: '4242 •••• •••• 4242'`, hardcoded name/email) — flag as placeholder data; split-payment selector cards duplicate markup twice |
| `components/tools/MasterDiagnosticModal.tsx` | 4-step diagnostic quiz modal (bottom-sheet style) | **Near-100% raw inline styles** | 351 lines; hardcoded to bottom-sheet/mobile modal (`alignItems:'flex-end'`, `borderBottomLeftRadius:0`) — will look wrong as a centered desktop modal; icon-tile card pattern duplicated 4× across steps |

**Admin pages** (all self-contained, each with its own large `<style>` string block — confirms the separate dark-navy/raw-CSS admin language):

| File | Style/type | Styling approach | Notable |
|---|---|---|---|
| `admin/page.tsx` | Dashboard (stat cards + quick-links + recent list) | className + big scoped `<style>` block (~165 lines of CSS) | Stat/quick-link grids use `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(...))` — actually has real responsive grid behavior, unlike consumer portal |
| `admin/clients/page.tsx` | Searchable list + detail `Modal` | className + `<style>` block (~310 lines CSS) | Largest admin file by CSS volume; list-card layout will overflow/cram on narrow widths since it's flex `justify-content:space-between` with no stacking breakpoint besides the modal grid |
| `admin/kanban/page.tsx` | **True Kanban board**, 10 hardcoded stage columns | className + `<style>` block | Columns are `min-width:220px;max-width:260px` in a horizontally-scrolling flex row — exactly the "needs real desktop columns" case; several stages (7, 10) always empty (dead columns); stage colors hardcoded hex in JS not CSS vars |
| `admin/filing-queue/page.tsx` | Filterable action list/queue | className + `<style>` block | Filter chips + search + card list; straightforward, reasonably responsive already (`repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr))`) |
| `admin/whatsapp/page.tsx` | Settings/console (send-message form + log list) | className + `<style>` block | 2-col grid (`admin-wa-grid`) collapses at 860px — one of the only real desktop breakpoints in the whole app |
| `admin/settings/page.tsx` | Simple settings page | className + `<style>` block, one inline `style` object (`badgeStyle` helper) | Capped `max-width:640px`, small/simple |

**Overall flags:**
- Files "unusually large" (500+ lines): none exceed 500 in isolation, but `admin/clients/page.tsx` (548 lines) is close, driven almost entirely by its embedded CSS block.
- Fake/placeholder data of note: `CheckoutForm.tsx` prefills a fake test card (`4242 •••• •••• 4242`), fake name/email, and simulates payment via `setTimeout` (no real gateway) — important for redesign scope (payment UI is decorative, not wired to a processor).
- Duplicated icon-tile pattern (`width/height 34-44px, borderRadius 10, flex center, colored bg`) is hand-repeated raw-inline dozens of times across `OnboardingWizard`, `CheckoutForm`, `MasterDiagnosticModal`, and `tools/page.tsx` — a strong candidate for a single `IconTile` component in the rebuild.
- Confirms prior finding: portal pages use the newer `design-system`/utility-class components (relatively clean), while `tools/page.tsx` and the onboarding/checkout/diagnostic components still use raw legacy inline styles — these three are the biggest inline-style offenders outside what's already been read.
- No literal `TODO`/broken code found in these files, but the admin Kanban board has structurally dead stages (7 "Active" and 10 "Archived" always render empty by design) worth flagging for the rebuild's data model.
